articles.summary: Periquitos e ilicitanos se enfrentan en la séptima jornada de la competición doméstica
articles.body: Espanyol y Elche se enfrentan el viernes 18 de septiembre a las 21:00 horas en el RCDE Stadium en el partido correspondiente a la séptima jornada de LaLiga EA Sports. El Espanyol llega al partido tras perder en la pasada jornada contra el Rayo Vallecano, mientras que el Elche llega al partido tras perder contra el Real Madrid. Los periquitos, situados en mitad de tabla, necesitan ganar para no descolgarse de los puestos europeos. Por su parte, los ilicitanos necesitan sumar puntos para dejar de ser el colista de Primera división. El partido entre Espanyol y Elche se juega el viernes 18 de septiembre a las 21:00 horas. El partido entre Espanyol y Elche de LaLiga EA Sports se podrá ver por televisión en directo a través de DAZN. También se podrá seguir el partido a través de la narración de Radio MARCA y con los comentarios en directo de MARCA.com. Desde dos horas antes, sigue la previa y los onces. Tras el encuentro, podrás leer la crónica, las declaraciones de los protagonistas y ver el resumen con las mejores jugadas y los goles. El Espanyol llega al partido de LaLiga EA Sports contra el Elche tras perder contra el Rayo Vallecano, se sitúa octavo con siete puntos. Los periquitos tienen por encima al Athletic Club con siete puntos y Racing de Santander con siete puntos. El Elche llega al partido de LaLiga EA Sports contra el Espanyol tras perder contra el Real Madrid, se sitúa vigésimo con dos puntos. Los ilicitanos tienen por debajo al Villarreal con dos puntos y Málaga con tres puntos.

articles.title: Mizzou Football Stock Risers and Fallers from Week 2
articles.summary: Who is up and what is down after beating KU?
articles.body:
Mizzou Football went into Lawrence and made a statement last Friday. The Tigers defeated the Jayhawks 38-21 to improve to 2-0 on the young season.

Against a Power Four opponent, it provided a much better level of competition than a team from the FCS. It revealed a lot of things, both good and bad, that you couldn't quite observe against UAPB.

With that being said, let's examine the stock risers and fallers from Week 2.

The rest of the college football world is starting to see the talent that Austin Simmons possesses. It's cool to see a sort of coming-out party happen at Kansas, out of all places. Now, we saw Beau Pribula have a strong start in 2025 (And Virginia is 3-0 this year), but the arm displayed live on the field explains why Eli Drinkwitz said before the season that he's the most talented quarterback he's had at MU, arm-talent-wise. He's throwing with anticipation, hitting tight-window throws, and launching lasers from one side all the way to the other sideline.

More importantly, and this brings a smile to my face, Simmons is attacking the deeper parts of the field, bringing out the talent of the wide receiver duo of Donovan Olugbode and Cayden Lee. One of the most impressive throws I thought he had on the night came right out of halftime, when he launched a deep ball off play action to Caleb Goodie, but the speedster just couldn't haul it in.

But also, credit goes to offensive coordinator Chip Lindsey. The OC-QB pairing is exactly what was hypothesized in the offseason. From Lindsey's standpoint, it was interesting to see what they did in the run game.

The Tigers' rushing attack hasn't been the road graders of the past, but Lindsey got creative to help provide a spark in the second quarter, where he called a sprint-draw, which opened up a 64-yard score for Jamal Roberts. He called that exact play three more times, going for 6, 6, and 13 yards, with the final helping set up a closer field goal.

Another player to have sort of a coming-out party was edge rusher Daeden Hopkins, who was named the SEC Defensive Lineman of the Week.

His 50 snaps also matched his season total from 2025. Against KU, PFF credited him with 8 pressures (He had 4 against Arkansas-Pine Bluff a season ago). He provided the final knockout blow with a strip sack, which led MU to go up 38-21. In a year where the edge rusher room has a lot to prove, Hopkins, Darris Smith, and Langden Kitchen have all looked the part. Hopkins' showing he can produce in a larger workload helps answer the questions of who will step up in the edge rusher room.

It's a wonderful story for the former four-star recruit from down the road at Hermann High School, who plays in Class 2 at the MSHSAA level.

Robert Woodyard Jr. was robbed of SEC Defensive Player of the Week honors. I talked about him already , and how he changed the momentum of the entire game with a forced fumble and an interception to start the second half, but he and Nicholas Rodriguez were all around the football, leading the team in tackles and combining for six pressures.

It's been a rough past couple of years for the Oregon transfer, but he has settled in as this team's No. 3 cornerback. For the most part, Mizzou's cornerbacks played well against Kansas.

As for Florence, he was targeted three times, allowing just one reception for three yards. His highlight play, of course, came on his interception while covering Keaton Kubecka. It was not an easy interception, as Kubecka originally had the catch, but Florence wanted it more, securing possession as he came down with it. Like at edge rusher and linebacker, the cornerback room had its questions as well. So far, they've performed well, and we'll see if that trend continues later in the season.

With Ahmad Hardy still out, Edwards received plenty of opportunities against Kansas. 10 carries for 45 yards might not seem like much, but per Nate Edwards, he had a 50% success rate when carrying the rock . On his touchdown run, his vision and extra effort to fight in the end zone were excellent, putting Mizzou up 28-14.

Against Troy, it will be interesting to see if he establishes himself more and makes it to where he can't be taken out of the rotation.

One blocked field goal is unacceptable, but two?? And one for a touchdown??

On the first one, the blocked one, the defender went right in between Jack Lange and Jordon Harris. The second came on the opposite side of the protection. Luckily, the errors didn't faze the Tigers. This game has been defined by special teams before (2008). Drinkwitz let us know his thoughts on the unit this Tuesday.

"Probably the most embarrassed I've been," Drinkwitz said. "And we've had some embarrassing special teams performances here. That was as embarrassing as I've been on special teams. To have two blocked kicks, and four penalties, two personal fouls on 15 yards, just inexcusable, and that's on me."

As mentioned above, Mizzou gained 89 yards on four rushing plays. Outside of those four, 88 yards on 37 attempts it's 2.37 yards per carry. The Tigers only had three rushes that went over 10 yards. It's been two weeks where it hasn't felt dominant up front; even with the return of Cayden Green, the Tigers gained just 5 yards on three attempts when running off the left tackle.

The issue is it's not going to get any easier after Troy. It's nine straight games against SEC defensive lines.

While Brett Norfleet helped put the game away with the team's final score, he had an egregious drop in the end zone, and on the following play, Kansas scored on a blocked field goal.

It represents kind of the start of what's been seen from the tight ends so far. Granted, the rest of the wide receiver room has been awesome, but the tight ends have been left out of the party. Norfleet has just 36 receiving yards on five receptions, and that makes up the entire statistical receiving profile for the entire tight end room.

As for Jordon Harris, he didn't have the best game against Kansas. Run blocking is his forte, and while PFF grades aren't everything, he finished with a 55.7 grade in that department. While Simmons was rolling out to the right in the first quarter, backed up in the end zone, the defender Harris was blocking was able to get in the air and bat the ball down.

Not the greatest start for the tight end room, but it's a long season.

articles.title: Journalist claims Real Madrid can sign Manchester United teenage gem for less than €1 million
articles.summary: Real Madrid could sign Manchester United teenage wonderkid JJ Gabriel for less than €1 million, according to journalist Mario Cortegana on his YouTube channe...
articles.body:
Real Madrid could sign Manchester United teenage wonderkid JJ Gabriel for less than €1 million, according to journalist Mario Cortegana on his YouTube channel (h/t Defensa Central ).

The 15-year-old is currently a part of the Manchester United academy and is regarded as one of the most promising young talents in English football.

However, he has handed in a transfer request to leave the Red Devils after growing unhappy and all signs point towards him joining Real Madrid.

Indeed, the Merengues have emerged as the frontrunners to sign Gabriel despite interest from several other top clubs including FC Barcelona and Manchester City .

Cortegana discussed the potential transfer on his YouTube channel, confirming Real Madrid's interest and explaining why the financial cost of the operation would be relatively low.

"Gabriel's signing for Madrid would cost less than €1 million in training compensation," the reliable journalist confirmed.

As mentioned earlier, Real Madrid would face competition from other major European clubs, but the financial side of the deal is unlikely to be the biggest obstacle.

Real Madrid leading race for Gabriel. (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images)

Paying less than €1 million in training compensation for a player considered one of Manchester United's leading academy prospects would represent a relatively modest investment for Real Madrid.

The greater challenge would be convincing Gabriel that REal Madrid can offer him the right pathway.

The teenager has already had exposure to senior football, but moving to the Spanish capital would place him in an environment with significant competition for places.

Cortegana stressed that Gabriel would not immediately become part of Jose Mourinho's first-team squad, but instead join Castilla .

"He wouldn't come to play in the first team straight away," Cortegana revealed.

Real Madrid have spent years targeting promising young players before their market values rise significantly.

That approach allows the club to identify talent at an early stage and compete for players before they become established stars.

However, every youngster follows a different development path, and progress does not always happen at the speed expected by the player or those around him.

Gabriel would therefore need time to adapt and develop after making the move.

One for the future. (Photo by Naomi Baker/Getty Images)

Cortegana pointed to Endrick as an example of how difficult the transition to Real Madrid's first team can be.

"Endrick is an example of what it costs," he stated.

The Brazilian arrived in Madrid with considerable experience from Palmeiras, international appearances and enormous expectations.

Even with that background, establishing himself as a regular first-team player has proved difficult.

Gabriel would arrive even younger and without sustained experience at the highest level. His talent has attracted significant attention, but several stages would still need to be completed before he could realistically establish himself with the senior team.

articles.title: Europa League official line-ups: Juventus vs NEC Nijmegen
articles.summary: Pape Matar Sarr, Nick Woltemade and Kamil Grabara get their first Juventus starts as Luciano Spalletti shuffles his pack for the Europa League opener against...
articles.body:
Pape Matar Sarr , Nick Woltemade and Kamil Grabara get their first Juventus starts as Luciano Spalletti shuffles his pack for the Europa League opener against NEC Nijmegen.

It kicks off at Allianz Stadium at 20.00 UK time (21.00 CEST).

This is the opening fixture in the league phase of the competition, so all the results go into a big table, facing four opponents at home and four away.

Juventus are in the Europa League after finishing sixth in Serie A last season, and arrive in need of a lift. Spalletti's side beat Parma and drew with Milan before Sunday's 3-2 collapse at Sassuolo , where Edon Zhegrova 's double off the bench twice hauled them level only for Vasilije Adzic to win it against his parent club in stoppage time. It is the second worst league start the Bianconeri have made in eight years, and the coach's position has become a talking point.

REGGIO NELL'EMILIA, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 13: Edon Zhegrova of Juventus celebrates after scoring his team's first goal during the Serie A match between US Sassuolo and Juventus at Mapei Stadium – Citta' del Tricolore on September 13, 2026 in Reggio nell'Emilia, Italy. (Photo by Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Images)

Zhegrova, remarkably, drops out despite those two goals, with Weston McKennie and Karim Alajbegovic supporting Woltemade in attack. Francisco Conceicao, therefore, makes way.

Federico Gatti comes into the back three, alongside Pierre Kalulu and Jhon Lucumi , while Sarr partners the retained Douglas Luiz in midfield. Nico Gonzalez and Zeki Celik take the flanks. Kamil Grabara starts in goal.

NEC are a tougher proposition than the name suggests. Dick Schreuder's side finished third in the Eredivisie last season, their best finish in decades, and reached the KNVB Cup final – a competition they have now lost six times without ever lifting it. They only dropped into this competition after losing a Champions League play-off to Bodo/Glimt.

Domestic form has been patchier, with the Dutch side currently 10th, though they warmed up for Turin with a 3-0 win over Cambuur.

This is NEC's first competitive meeting with Juventus, and the start of a league phase that also takes them to Dinamo Zagreb and Benfica.

articles.title: Flick will keep faith in Barcelona veteran star against Sevilla despite costly mistake
articles.summary: FC Barcelona’s goalkeeping situation is under the spotlight ahead of Saturday’s visit to Sevilla. The minor knee problem suffered by Joan Garcia has opened t...
articles.body:
FC Barcelona 's goalkeeping situation is under the spotlight ahead of Saturday's visit to Sevilla .

The minor knee problem suffered by Joan Garcia has opened the door for Wojciech Szczesny to return to the starting XI.

Garcia felt discomfort in his knee after slipping during the recent match against Racing Santander.

Medical tests confirmed that there is no serious injury , but Barça's priority is to avoid taking any unnecessary risks with their first-choice goalkeeper.

That makes Szczesny the leading candidate to start at the Ramon Sanchez-Pizjuan this weekend, with Hansi Flick continuing to trust the veteran goalkeeper reports SPORT .

Szczesny remains second in the pecking order

There had been some uncertainty over the hierarchy after Dominik Livakovic joined Barcelona towards the end of the transfer window.

The Croatian international's arrival appeared to create direct competition for the role of second-choice goalkeeper.

Szczesny made a critical error against Racing Santander. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images)

Flick, however, quickly made his position clear by confirming Szczesny as the immediate deputy to Garcia.

That confidence has not changed following the Polish goalkeeper's mistake in his most recent appearance against Racing, where his error led to a goal.

Flick played down the incident in his post-match press conference, stressing that mistakes are part of football and expressing his belief that Szczesny will produce a strong performance in his next opportunity.

Only Szczesny himself could change the plan

Szczesny's commitment to Barcelona is another factor valued by Flick and his coaching staff.

The Polish goalkeeper came out of retirement to join Barcelona after Marc-Andre ter Stegen suffered a serious injury two seasons ago.

Barcelona hold Szczesny in high regard. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images)

His willingness to return to professional football and immediately integrate himself into the squad strengthened the trust placed in him by the coaching staff.

That commitment remains an important part of his standing within the group.

There could still be a conversation between Flick and Szczesny before the match, and the goalkeeper could theoretically decide that he does not want to take on the responsibility. Short of that, however, the plan appears clear.

Despite the debate surrounding some of Szczesny's previous performances and the criticism generated by his costly mistake against Racing, the technical staff's position remains unchanged.

Unless Garcia's situation improves enough for him to return, Szczesny is expected to defend Barcelona's goal in Seville.

articles.title: Official Juventus team to face NEC Nijmegen
articles.summary: NEC are the next opponents who will try to make Juventus’ season worse than it has been so far, and this is the team that has been selected to make sure that...
articles.body:
NEC are the next opponents who will try to make Juventus ' season worse than it has been so far, and this is the team that has been selected to make sure that does not happen.

Their loss to Sassuolo at the weekend was painful, but Juve showed in the closing stages of that game that they are capable of responding when things do not go their way. Their fans will expect the players to produce that response with a win in this match.

Juventus Looking for a Strong European Start

Juve are one of the top clubs in the Europa League this season, so expectations will be high as they begin their campaign. The Bianconeri have the quality to perform well in the competition and will be looking to demonstrate that from their opening fixture.

They have one of the best teams in the tournament, but their start to the competition could play an important role in determining how far they go. A positive result would give the players something to build on after their disappointing recent results in Serie A.

NEC arrive in Turin without a win in their last three matches, and they could feel that this is a good time to face Juventus. The Dutch side will know that their opponents have also struggled to win games recently, which could give them confidence ahead of the fixture.

However, Juventus have had a better start to the season, while playing at home gives them another advantage on paper. NEC will therefore be prepared for a difficult night in Turin as they attempt to cause an upset against one of the competition's most established clubs.

There has been no previous meeting between Juventus and NEC, meaning the Bianconeri have the opportunity to earn the bragging rights in the first fixture between the clubs.

Playing in front of their own supporters should provide Juve with further encouragement, particularly after their recent struggles. The players will want to give the fans a reason to believe that their season can quickly change direction.

NEC will have their own plans and will hope Juventus' recent form gives them an opportunity, but the Bianconeri know the importance of starting their European campaign positively. A victory would allow them to put their recent dropped points behind them and begin their Europa League journey with confidence.

articles.title: Omaha among three host cities for the FIVB Women's World Cup in 2027
articles.summary: The 32-nation FIVB World Cup will be played in Anaheim, California, Omaha, Nebraska and Orlando, Florida in 2027.
articles.body:
The 2027 FIVB Women's Volleyball World Cup will be played in the United States and Canada in 2027.

United States host cities for the tournament were announced on Thursday, Sept. 17. The 32-nation tournament will be played in Anaheim, California (Honda Center), Omaha, Nebraska (CHI Health Center Arena) and Orlando, Florida (Kia Center). The tournament will run from Aug. 20-Sept. 5, 2027.

The Canadian host cities will be announced at a later date.

"Congratulations to my friends in Orlando on being selected to host the 2027 FIVB Women's Volleyball World Cup," said Misty May-Treanor, three-time Olympic gold medalist. "I know firsthand how powerful it is to compete in front of passionate fans, and I also know how inspiring it can be for young athletes to witness the world's best players in person.

"Bringing the FIVB Volleyball Women's World Cup to Orlando gives young girls throughout Central Florida the opportunity to dream bigger, work harder and see what's possible through sport."

NCAA volleyball Final Four tips off in Kansas City

Omaha and Orlando will host pool play and round of 16 matches. The Honda Center in Anaheim will host the quarterfinals, semifinals and finals in 2027, and then serve as the host venue for the men's and women's indoor volleyball competition for the 2028 Summer Olympic Games in Los Angeles.

"It's an exciting opportunity to host the Women's Volleyball World Cup on home soil just one year before the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, and playing in front of our home crowd gives us an advantage to test ourselves and build momentum," U.S. women's national team coach Erick Sullivan said. "Experiencing that level of high-stakes competition enhances our Olympic preparation. Our fans play a massive role in creating the environment we need to thrive, and their energy will elevate our performance."

articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs recently started out their season with a bang by defeating the Denver Broncos in blowout fashion on Monday Night Football. This game m...
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs recently started out their season with a bang by defeating the Denver Broncos in blowout fashion on Monday Night Football. This game marked the return of quarterback Patrick Mahomes after an ACL injury cut his season short last year, and he had some strong moments in his first game back.

Mahomes has become known for posting clock emojis on social media both on his own feed and in the comment sections of others, and now, the inspiration for this practice has been revealed.

"He said growing up, his father and his father's friends gave him the nickname '2pm.' That goes back to his initials, PM, and also the fact that he was Patrick Mahomes II. You add those together, you get 2pm," reported Jesse Newell of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter.

Mahomes started out the game against the Broncos a bit rusty, including throwing a brutal interception in the third quarter on a miscommunication with wide receiver Xavier Worthy , but he largely got it together in the second half, hitting Travis Kelce for a huge gain on one particularly memorable play.

This year, the Chiefs are looking to retake their throne in the AFC after a down year in 2025 that saw the team miss the playoffs altogether, something they were well on their way to doing before Mahomes suffered his injury.

While there are still questions about Kansas City's receiving core and how its defensive depth will hold up, they certainly aced their first test of the season against Denver.

articles.title: English FA calls for Infantino to release FIFA World Cup sell-off documents
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino’s World Cup selloff plan has faced global backlash with English FA latest to seek document release.
articles.body:
The chair of the English Football Association (FA) has called on FIFA President Gianni Infantino to release all the documentation relating to the abandoned plan to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors.

Infantino’s proposal was short-lived after a fierce backlash from across the sport, with European governing body UEFA threatening to boycott all FIFA competitions until it was shelved.

FA chair Debbie Hewitt, who is also a FIFA vice-president and a member of the FIFA Council, has written to Infantino asking for full disclosure of all information relating to the scheme before the FIFA Council next meets on October 15.

Hewitt has also called for the release of documents relating to the decision to suspend a ban handed to United States striker Folarin Balogun during the World Cup, which followed a phone call from US President Donald Trump to Infantino.

Infantino apologised for the process in regard to the private investor plan in August, and a statement from FIFA’s management board pledged there would be a review but has not at any stage confirmed who is undertaking that investigation.

UEFA said it has “lost confidence” in Infantino and has made legal applications in the US court system seeking disclosure of documents related to the private investor plan.

UEFA has also committed to identifying a credible candidate to run against Infantino at the FIFA Congress in March, with November 18 the deadline for candidates to be submitted.

Infantino confirmed earlier this month his intention to seek re-election.

articles.title: El Salzburgo le corta las alas a Julio Velázquez y su Levski Sofía
articles.standfirst: El gol de Tabakovic antes del descanso dio el triunfo (0-1) al conjunto de la Factoría RB
articles.summary: El gol de Tabakovic antes del descanso dio el triunfo (0-1) al conjunto de la Factoría RB
articles.body: Julio Velázquez, tras poner fin a 14 años de tiranía en Bulgaria por parte de Ludogorets, se quedó a un paso de llevar a su Levski Sofía a la Champions. Se conformaron con la Europa League... y el Salzburgo (0-1) les ha cortado las alas en la jornada inaugural. La realidad es que el Levski entró bastante entonado al partido. De hecho, el primer disparo del Salzburgo, a cargo de Vertessen, no llegó hasta que se superaron los primeros 20' de encuentro. Tabakovic, sin embargo, aprovechó un deficiente despeje por parte de Dimitrov para poner por delante a los de Danny Röhl. Noveno gol del curso para el punta bosnio, que no fue citado al Mundial. Le hizo daño el gol a un Levski Sofía que no estuvo lejos de encajar el 0-2 durante los primeros compases de la segunda parte. Julio Velázquez, incluso, reaccionó retirando antes de alcanzar la hora de partido a un Álex Centelles (canterano del Valencia y ex del Almería) que estaba formando doble lateral por banda izquierda. Le sentó bien al Levski. Comenzaron a acumular disparos... pero ninguno terminaba de coger dirección a puerta. Contuvo el 'arreón' y logró conservar el 0-1 para arrancar con buen pie su andadura en una Europa League donde, el curso pasado, quedaron apeados a las primeras de cambio. Los octavos de final alcanzados en la Copa de la UEFA 93-94 tras eliminar al Atlético de Madrid sigue siendo la mayor gesta en Europa por parte del OFI Creta. Sumaban seis temporadas sin competir en Europa League... y han regresado por todo lo alto imponiéndose a todo un Hoffenheim (2-0) que nunca llegó a encontrarse a su paso por Grecia. Tenía claro el OFI Creta que, si quería sacar algo positivo, el plan pasaba por hacerse fuerte atrás e intentar sacar rédito de sus pocas salidas a la contra. El Hoffenheim, salvo algún disparo desde fuera del área, nunca les llegó a incomodar... y entre Kenan Kodro y Aitor Cantalapiedra se encargaron de hacer saltar la sorpresa justo cuando se cumplía la hora de partido. Ilzer dio entrada al descanso a Machida en el eje de la zaga en el lugar de un Hajdari que salió señalado en el 1-0. Perdonó Fountas el segundo en el 53'. Sin embargo, se mostraron tremendamente sólidos ante un Hoffenheim carente de ideas en busca del empate... y Kanellopoulos se encargó de sentenciar el choque en el 84' a la salida de un córner. Primera gran sorpresa de esta Europa League.

articles.title: Abde derriba el muro azulón para que el Betis prolongue su racha ganadora
articles.standfirst: Un gol del marrroquí en su semana más difícil le da la tercera victoria seguida a su equipo
articles.summary: Un gol del marrroquí en su semana más difícil le da la tercera victoria seguida a su equipo
articles.body: El Betis encadenó ante el Getafe su tercera victoria consecutiva en LaLiga y confirmó las buenas sensaciones que había dejado en Villarreal con un triunfo mucho más ajustado en el marcador que en el juego. Abde decidió justo antes del descanso un partido correoso, pero dominado durante muchos minutos con enorme autoridad por los verdiblancos, que se encontraron una y otra vez con David Soria y perdonaron ocasiones suficientes para haber evitado el sufrimiento final. Deossa firmó una actuación sobresaliente, Antony fue una amenaza permanente y Valles volvió a aparecer cuando fue necesario para proteger tres puntos que permiten al equipo de Pellegrini seguir mirando hacia arriba, en la tercera plaza de la tabla con 15 puntos de 18 posibles. El conjunto andaluz, que saltó al césped acompañado de sus once socios más longevos, fue dueño absoluto de la primera parte, aunque necesitó esperar hasta el último suspiro para trasladar al marcador una superioridad evidente casi desde el inicio. Los verdiblancos monopolizaron el balón, jugaron durante muchos minutos alrededor del área de David Soria y se marcharon al vestuario con un abrumador 80,4% de posesión y 13 remates por sólo tres del Getafe. Un dominio casi total que, sin embargo, no evitó que los de Bordalás generaran peligro en sus escasas llegadas y obligaran a Valles a resultar determinante de nuevo. El equipo de Pellegrini quiso imprimirle mucho dinamismo al juego desde el principio. Antony avisó ya en la primera transición y Parrott estuvo a punto de sorprender a Soria con un disparo desde unos 50 metros que el guardameta despejó con apuros. Entre medias, una mala cesión de Facundo había permitido al Getafe amenazar por primera vez, pero Valles salió rápido para evitar el remate de Azón y a continuación respondió al disparo de Francho. Poco después volvió a aparecer el portero bético con una mano salvadora ante un incisivo Azón tras un balón largo de Zaid Romero. Se señaló fuera de juego, no lo parecía. Antony se convirtió en la principal amenaza bética. Después de obligar a Soria a intervenir con uno de sus habituales movimientos de fuera hacia dentro, el brasileño estuvo muy cerca de marcar con una espectacular volea desde la frontal que salió a 110 kilómetros por hora. El portero azulón reaccionó con una mano asombrosa, desvió el balón al poste y tuvo además la fortuna de que el rechace regresara directamente a sus manos. Poco después, Facundo rozó el larguero con un 'misil' desde fuera del área con Soria batido. El asedio en ese momento ya era total. El Getafe, que había pedido tarjeta para Firpo por un plantillazo a Francho, consiguió rebajar las revoluciones del partido en el tramo final del primer tiempo. Las faltas, las interrupciones y un bloque cada vez más cerrado terminaron con la fluidez que había mostrado el Betis durante buena parte de la primera media hora. Isco, muy participativo y sin ningún temor al contacto tras su grave lesión, llegó incluso a quejarse a Sánchez Martínez de las continuas interrupciones con un "es que así no podemos jugar". El conjunto de Bordalás parecía haber conseguido llegar indemne al descanso. Pero justo entonces apareció el premio. Deossa, elegido por Pellegrini para añadir músculo al centro del campo y protagonista de una notable primera parte, ganó un duelo y lanzó en largo a Abde. El marroquí controló, conectó con Antony y el brasileño filtró el balón para Parrott, que en lugar de rematar tuvo la lucidez de devolverlo atrás. Abde, que había continuado la carrera, apareció para culminar una magnífica acción colectiva. El VAR revisó durante aproximadamente un minuto una posible mano del extremo en el control inicial, pero terminó validando un gol que hacía justicia a lo visto antes del descanso. El gol no solo cerró el primer tiempo sino que fue un regalo para un futbolista, el marroquí, al que su familia aplaudía desde un palco, y que lo ha pasado mal estos días. Salir junto a sus compañeros con una camiseta de apoyo a Ceuta el lunes en el partido frente al Villarreal de La Cerámica provocó que su cuenta de Instagram se llenada de duras críticas, insultos y amenazas. Tuvo incluso que compartir un comunicado para explicar lo sucedido y su entrenador, Pellegrini, salió al paso para intentar diferenciar fútbol de política. Pellegrini movió ficha en el descanso para proteger a Ángel Ortiz, condicionado por su amarilla, dando entrada a Bellerín, mientras Bordalás sustituyó al también amonestado Davinchi por Mojica y buscó mayor presencia ofensiva con Enes Ünal por Satriano. El Getafe adelantó durante unos minutos sus líneas para intentar dificultar la salida de balón verdiblanca, pero el Betis siguió manejando el partido desde la posesión. Pudo además ampliar muy pronto su ventaja: un extraordinario cambio de orientación de Deossa permitió progresar a Abde y Junior y, tras un mal despeje de Djené, Isco remató fuera, completamente solo. El capitán dejó su sitio en el 61' a Dani Ceballos, que volvió a jugar ante la afición bética nueve años después. Para entonces, el Getafe había comprobado que ni siquiera dando un paso adelante conseguía arrebatarle la pelota a un Betis que redujo riesgos y comenzó a administrar su ventaja. Más que buscar permanentemente el segundo, los de Pellegrini utilizaron el balón para controlar a un rival que apenas encontraba la manera de acercarse a Valles. Pese a ese ritmo más pausado, las mejores oportunidades siguieron siendo verdiblancas. Riquelme, recién ingresado junto a Cucho, se encontró con Soria después de una buena incorporación de Bellerín y una rocambolesca sucesión de rechaces estuvo a punto de terminar con el segundo. Antony volvió a rozarlo poco después tras enlazar dos paredes consecutivas con Bellerín y Riquelme, pero nuevamente apareció Soria. El brasileño lo intentó de todas las maneras sin encontrar el premio a uno de sus partidos más incisivos. La sentencia volvió a escaparse en el 85'. Ceballos encontró con un magnífico pase a Junior, el lateral puso el balón atrás y Antony remató con Soria ya superado, pero Zaid Romero apareció bajo palos para evitar un gol que se cantaba en La Cartuja. Segundos después, Mario Martín llegó muy tarde a un balón dividido y se llevó por delante a Natan. Sánchez Martínez le mostró la segunda amarilla y dejó al Getafe con diez. Para entonces, Deossa se había convertido en uno de los grandes nombres de la noche, dominando duelos, imponiendo su físico y manejando además la pelota con criterio. Ni siquiera la superioridad numérica permitió al Betis ahorrarse unos últimos minutos de inquietud. Pellegrini pidió a Ceballos que alargara las posesiones, pero aparecieron los nervios Azón probó fortuna y el Getafe, sin nada que perder, terminó lanzándose arriba. Ünal llegó incluso a quedarse solo ante Valles, que respondió con otro paradón, aunque la acción quedó invalidada por fuera de juego. Deossa todavía tuvo fuerzas para fabricar en el descuento una última llegada que Ceballos mandó muy desviada. El Betis había tenido oportunidades de sobra para sentenciar mucho antes, pero terminó defendiendo hasta el último suspiro una ventaja mínima que se quedó corta para los méritos acumulados durante el partido.

Lionel Messi and MLS commissioner Don Garber appeared to have a heated exchange Wednesday after the Inter Miami star led his team to a 2-0 victory over Cruz Azul to win the Campeones Cup.

As the Associated Press noted, Messi pointed at Garber multiple times as they were speaking after the game. Messi did so originally and walked away, but he was later seen pointing at Garber again as they were interacting.

articles.title: Deossa, MVP ante el Getafe: "En casa no se nos pueden llevar ni un punto"
articles.standfirst: Gran actuación del colombiano, que firma su mejor semana desde que llegó al Betis
articles.summary: Gran actuación del colombiano, que firma su mejor semana desde que llegó al Betis
articles.body: Nelson Deossa, tras su portentosa actuación el lunes en La Cerámica jugando unos minutos en la segunda parte, fue titular esta tarde en la victoria del Betis frente al Getafe por 1-0 en La Cartuja. El colombiano desplegó su mejor versión, su fútbol físico, ganador de duelos y de conducciones, pero dejó también mucho orden en la distribución de balón. Un rendimiento por el que fue elegido MVP del encuentro, algo que valoró así en DAZN. Elegido MVP: "No, la verdad que no me lo esperaba. Siempre salgo a la cancha a dar lo mejor de mí, lo mejor por el equipo y, si me dan ese reconocimiento, es importante porque quiere decir que hizo las cosas muy bien". La victoria y el gol de Abde: "Sí, la verdad que importantísimo siempre poder sumar en casa y poder ganar. Siempre es bueno sumar de a tres y, claro, contento por mi hermano Abde que ha vuelto y que hoy se encontró con el gol". Racha de partidos invictos: "No, la verdad que nos preparamos muy bien para eso. Lo hablamos siempre, en casa no se nos pueden llevar ni un punto y es lo que venimos ratificando partidos atrás y hoy es muestra de ese resultado". Terceros empatados con el Real Madrid: "Es importantísimo eso, también competir contra los más grandes y esperamos poder mantenernos durante mucho tiempo en esas posiciones".

articles.title: Pellegrini: "Tener 15 puntos de 18 no es fácil, y menos con un partido de Champions en medio"
articles.standfirst: El Ingeniero destaca el gran arranque de temporada de su equipo tras imponerse al Getafe
articles.summary: El Ingeniero destaca el gran arranque de temporada de su equipo tras imponerse al Getafe
articles.body: Manuel Pellegrini, técnico del Betis, se mostró muy satisfecho con el rendimiento de su equipo en su segundo partido de la semana, en el que logró imponerse por 1-0 en La Cartuja al siempre complicado Getafe de Bordalás. El Ingeniero, en DAZN, destacó la alta puntuación liguera de los verdiblancos, que también ganaron en su estreno en Champions, y aplaudió el partido de Abde y el regreso de Dani Ceballos. Gran arranque de temporada: "Muy contento. Tener 15 puntos de 18 no es fácil, y más insertando un partido de la Champions de visita con el puntero del torneo francés y ganarlo. Creo que es un comienzo muy motivador y de mucha exigencia, de continuar intentando llegar siempre lo más arriba posible". Análisis del partido: "El Getafe es un equipo complicado, que defiende mucho y que es muy fuerte. Por suerte logramos convertir ese gol. Tuvimos tres o cuatro ocasiones de gol bastante claras. El equipo estuvo muy bien en defensa; prácticamente no llegaron a nuestra portería. Si no se puede hacer más de un gol, tenemos que saber mantener la portería en blanco, pero siempre teniendo la posesión del balón en campo rival e intentando buscar el segundo gol". Gran nivel de Abde tras su lesión: "Es mucho tiempo: son prácticamente cuatro meses en los que no ha podido jugar con continuidad, por eso le hacemos jugar como máximo 70 minutos. Ahora tiene la reincorporación a la selección de Marruecos. Es un jugador muy importante, con mucha potencia y que nos marca la diferencia". Bordalás reclamó en el gol de Abde: "No he visto la repetición del gol, así que no podría opinar. Pero si no era el gol, también tuvimos tiros en los palos y paradas de su portero. Creo que el justo vencedor fuimos nosotros; el Getafe se defendió muy bien, pero a nuestra portería prácticamente no llegó". Valles pide sitio en la Selección: "Ser seleccionador es muy difícil, no solo en el puesto de portero sino en todos los puestos del campo, al haber tantas alternativas en tantos equipos. Estoy seguro de que Luis de la Fuente va a saber elegir a los mejores". El regreso de Ceballos: "Es muy importante. Es un jugador que salió de la cantera y se fue nada menos que ocho años a un equipo como el Real Madrid, donde no es fácil mantenerse tanto tiempo. Vuelve además con mucha ilusión. Teniendo distintas alternativas, esperó al Betis hasta el final porque quería volver a su casa, así que nos está haciendo un aporte muy importante".

articles.title: Luis García: "No podemos estar ciegos, hay mucho margen de mejora"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Mallorca pide que la Segunda también se pare por los compromisos de las selecciones
articles.summary: El técnico del Mallorca pide que la Segunda también se pare por los compromisos de las selecciones
articles.body: el técnico del RCD Mallorca, Luis García, admitió este jueves en la previa del duelo ante la Real Sociedad B que él y sus jugadores no pueden "ser ciegos" ante el juego que está mostrando el equipo, que aún tiene "mucho margen de mejora". "Tenemos que mejorar en el juego con el mismo equilibrio que conseguimos resultados. Si consiguiéramos buen juego pero no resultados, no serviría. Hay que ser muy competitivos y luchar por cosas bonitas, no podemos ser ciegos, tenemos mucha mejora", aseguró. Uno de los aspectos que deben corregir con mayor urgencia es el rendimiento lejos de Son Moix: "Hay que ayudar al equipo a encontrar mejores versiones fuera de casa; tenemos que seguir siendo competitivos fuera de casa porque necesitamos ganar lejos de Son Moix para completar el objetivo, no hay diferencia entre unos partidos y otros, es más difícil pero tenemos plantilla para luchar por ganar cualquier partido", declaró. El entrenador bermellón volvió a pedir que se detenga LaLiga Hypermotion durante el parón de selecciones, porque la segunda categoría "cada vez tiene más nivel y los jugadores van con sus selecciones". "Debe plantearse seriamente que pare durante las ventanas. No lo puedo controlar, si (Martin) Valjent va con Eslovaquia es porque hace las cosas bien, al igual que otros, es bueno para ellos, pero si no están hay oportunidades para otros", señaló. "Lo más importante es este partido -apuntó sobre el enfrentamiento contra la Real Sociedad B-, no podemos irnos más allá. Pensando en la posición de centrales está David que no ha participado, Soumahoro lo ha hecho menos, pero no podemos pensar más lejos de este fin de semana", añadió. García restó importancia a jugar en Zubieta en lugar de en Anoeta, y advirtió del peligro del rival. "Son chicos jóvenes con un futuro muy bueno por delante, el año pasado les da un bagaje al hacer las cosas muy bien. Todos los partidos son difíciles y hay que sacar nuestra mejor versión", indicó.

articles.title: Djené cree que "han competido muy bien" pese a la derrota y pide "tranquilidad"
articles.standfirst: "En el arbitraje no me meto, solo en lo mío", asegura el internacional togolés
articles.summary: "En el arbitraje no me meto, solo en lo mío", asegura el internacional togolés
articles.body: El defensa togolés del Getafe Djené Dakonam consideró que su equipo ha "competido muy bien", a pesar de la derrota ante el Betis (1-0) en el Estadio La Cartuja, y lanzó un mensaje de "tranquilidad" a la afición azulona y a sus compañeros. El internacional por Togo destacó la evolución del conjunto madrileño pese a no haber podido sumar en su visita a Sevilla. "Hemos competido muy bien, encajamos un gol que podemos evitar, porque hemos trabajado mucho en eso, pero tenemos que seguir", afirmó al acabar el partido. "El mensaje que mando es tranquilidad, a la afición y a mis compañeros, porque llegará el momento", recalcó el central del Getafe. Djené evitó pronunciarse sobre la actuación arbitral y centró su análisis en el rendimiento del equipo. "En el arbitraje no me meto, solo en lo mío. Estamos mejorando mucho cada semana y tenemos que seguir trabajando porque LaLiga este año será muy difícil", manifestó. El defensa africano también tuvo palabras de reconocimiento para el guardameta David Soria, quien mantuvo al Getafe en el partido con varias intervenciones, le dio "la enhorabuena" a su compañero y aseguró que "es de los mejores porteros de LaLiga, sigue demostrándolo" y, aunque este jueves "no se ha ganado", les "ayuda un montón".

articles.standfirst: Ni Bordalás ni Djené quisieron volver a entrar en polémica tars las accioens de Firpo y el gol dudoso del Real Betis
articles.summary: Ni Bordalás ni Djené quisieron volver a entrar en polémica tars las accioens de Firpo y el gol dudoso del Real Betis
articles.body: El Real Betis - Getafe dejó dos acciones muy polémicas en la retina de los aficionados. Sobre todo, la de los aficionados del Getafe. En la primera entrada, una aparatosa entrada de Firpo quedó sin castigo. Una acción muy parecida a la que en la primera jornada dejaba a Kiko Femenía en la caseta por una roja directa. “En el tema de los árbitros no me meto”, decía Djené Dakonam, que no quiso avivar un fuego que lleva candente desde la primera jornada: “Lo que puedo decir hoy es que tenemos que seguir trabajando, LaLiga será muy difícil. Hoy hemos mejorado respecto a la semana pasada”, sentenciaba el togolés. La segunda acción llegaba tras el gol del Real Betis, revisada desde el VAR pero a la que el colegiado no fue llamado para verla, en dos momentos de la jugada en la que normalmente se acude al monitor para chequear que no ha habido nada punible. Lo primero, una mano de Ez Abde, pegada al cuerpo pero con la que Bordalás afirmaba que “se ayuda para amortiguar el balón”. Un punto de la jugada que, para el alicantino, debía haber sido objeto de infracción: “Esas acciones suelen ser mano”, decía. Tras esa acción y antes del golpeo y el gol del marroquí, Isco, en posición antirreglamentaria, podría intervenir en la jugada al dificultar la visión de David Soria. Algo que también puntualizaba el entrenador azulón: “Esa jugada del gol es cuanto menos muy dudosa. Estaba Isco ahí, estiró la pierna y le tapó la visibilidad a David Soria”, afirmaba. Pese a ello, Bordalás no quiso hablar de los árbitros, ni quiso entrar en ninguna polémica. En otras ocasiones, ya destacó el rasero con el que miden a su equipo respecto a otro y lo cierto es que, tras las seis primeras jornadas, el bagaje es demoledor, con cuatro rojas y dos penaltis en contra. "La de Firpo es vidente, no digo nada más, porque son muy claras y me callo porque parece que me quejo de todo y no es así. En la roja nuestra, Mario quita la pierna, no lleva maldad, llega tarde pero se ve que la encoje, tenemos que aprender también de esas acciones...". El equipo perderá a Mario Martín para el duelo frente al Málaga en el Coliseum, que desde el vestuario ya tienen marcado en rojo para volver a sumar de tres y dar un salto en la tabla.

articles.title: El City arranca la defensa de la Carabao sin despeinarse
articles.standfirst: Cómodo triunfo ante el Norwich (5-0) en el Etihad · El canterano Floyd Samba debutó con un doblete · Se medirán al Brighton en la siguiente ronda
articles.summary: Cómodo triunfo ante el Norwich (5-0) en el Etihad · El canterano Floyd Samba debutó con un doblete · Se medirán al Brighton en la siguiente ronda
articles.body: No hubo sorpresa esta noche en el lado 'skyblue' de Mánchester. El City, campeón de la pasada edición de la Carabao tras derrocar al Arsenal en la final, arrancó su defensa del título copero goleando al Norwich (5-0) en el Etihad sin necesidad de despeinarse. Maresca ya adelantó en rueda de prensa que iba a dar minutos a los jugadores menos habituales. De hecho, a excepción de Cherki, no repitió ninguno de los titulares en el 'Derby of Manchester'. La presencia de Rulli bajo palos, Vitor Reis en el eje de la zaga y Allan en banda fue lo más destacado. El canterano Floyd Samba (2009), además, hizo su debut oficial. Le costó al Manchester City ensamblar las piezas con tantos cambios en el once inicial. De hecho, más allá de un disparo cruzado de Rico Lewis por encima del larguero desde dentro del área antes de llegar al 10' tras una buena descarga de Floyd Samba al primer toque, les costó generarle ocasiones al Norwich. La circulación del balón por parte del conjunto 'cityzen' estaba siendo demasiado lenta y, sobre todo, incurrieron en alguna que otra pérdida no forzada que les pudo costar un disgusto. A los 28', sin embargo, Floyd Samba aprovechó una deficiente salida por alto de Grimshaw y se lanzó en plancha para cabecear un envío de Allan. Inmejorable estreno para ambos. El Manchester City cogió 'carrerilla' y, menos de cinco minutos después, Rayan Cherki se encargó de duplicar la renta. De nuevo, intervino Samba descargando de espaldas para que Bouaddi lanzase al espacio al talentoso mediapunta francés, que ya ha generado cinco goles en este inicio de curso. No estaba el partido cerrado... pero el City sí lo había dejado bastante encarrilado al descanso. Maresca, incluso, se permitió el lujo de retirar al propio Cherki y darle la alternativa a Ryan McAidoo (2008), otra de las grandes perlas de la cantera en la que el club tiene depositadas muchas esperanzas de cara a futuro. Allan, por si acaso, se encargó de poner tierra de por medio nada más arrancar la segunda parte. El ex de Palmeiras, fichado este verano, recibió en el 'piquito' del área, salió del uno contra uno por fuera y fusiló por el palo corto. Debut soñado para un futbolista que, sobre el papel, parte como cuarta opción para Maresca en banda por detrás de Doku, Semenyo y Ndiaye. El Norwich ya bajó los brazos y, pocos minutos después, Floyd Samba redondeó su noche marcando su doblete tras un grotesco error en salida de balón. Tampoco pisó el acelerador el Manchester City. El correctivo estaba siendo contundente y guardaron fuerzas de cara al choque de este fin de semana frente a un siempre combativo Sunderland. A McAidoo, eso sí, le dio tiempo a sellar la 'manita'. La Carabao Cup avanza a ritmo vertiginoso y, aunque todavía quede lejos la final que se disputará el próximo 21 de marzo de 2027 en Wembley, ya se conocen los enfrentamientos que tendrán lugar en la Cuarta Ronda del torneo. De los 16 equipos que quedan vivos en el torneo, tan sólo hay tres que no militan esta campaña en la Premier League. Todos los encuentros están programados para la semana del 26 de octubre. El duelo estrella, sin ninguna duda, será el que protagonizarán Liverpool y Chelsea... con dos amigos como Andoni Iraola y Xabi Alonso en sus respectivos banquillos. El Manchester City, vigente, campeón, se medirá a un Brighton que viene de eliminar al Manchester United... mientras que el Arsenal, finalista, se medirá al Fleetwood de League Two (Cuarta división).

articles.title: Bianconeri put five past NEC in the Europa League
articles.summary: The Men's First Team began their 2026/27 UEFA Europa League campaign with a commanding 5-0 victory against NEC Nijmegen.The goals came from five different pl...
articles.body:
The Men's First Team began their 2026/27 UEFA Europa League campaign with a commanding 5-0 victory against NEC Nijmegen.

The goals came from five different players, as Nico Gonzalez , Kerim Alajbegovic, Nick Woltemade , Zeki Celik and Randal Kolo Muani all found the back of the net.

It was a flying start at the Allianz Stadium for the Bianconeri , who approached the match with the right attitude, immediately pinning the Dutch side NEC back in their own half. The deadlock was broken in the 9th minute. Kamil Grabara played a perfect long ball from the back to find Nico Gonzalez making a run. The Argentine striker pounced on the ball at just the right moment, capitalising on the opposing goalkeeper's hesitation as he came off his line, and coolly slotted the ball into the net to make it 1-0.

Buoyed by their lead, Luciano Spalletti's side continued to press forward. In the 23rd minute, Nick Woltemade had the chance to double the lead. The striker found himself with the ball in the heart of the penalty area following a deflection, but the NEC goalkeeper managed to deny him. It was merely a prelude to the second goal, which arrived right on cue a minute later, in the 24th minute. There was a one-two on the edge of the box between Weston McKennie and Kerim Alajbegovic, with the latter controlling the ball and unleashing a powerful, clinical right-footed shot that nestled unstoppably into the corner.

Juventus' pressure did not let up and, in the 35th minute, Gonzalez dribbled into the box where he was clearly brought down. The referee had no hesitation in awarding a penalty. Woltemade stepped up to the spot and coolly sent Nikolas Polster the wrong way, making it 3-0 in the 35th minute.

The second half got off to a similar start to the first. The Bianconeri managed their three-goal lead with composure, maintaining complete control of the ball and biding their time to punish the Dutch defence once more.

The fresh legs brought on from the bench added further spark to the Bianconeri's attack, and in the 75th minute the fourth goal arrived. Randal Kolo Muani produced a dazzling solo run down the wing, breaking through NEC's defence and delivering an inviting cross into the box for Zeki Celik, who slotted home from close range to make it 4-0.

The magical evening at the Allianz Stadium continued with another moment of joy in the 82nd minute. A long ball from Jhon Lucumi found Kolo Muani's run in behind. The French striker beat the defenders to the ball, rounded the onrushing goalkeeper and slotted home into an empty net to seal the 5-0 victory.

articles.title: Yeremy Pino se merece un palacio
articles.standfirst: El campeón del mundo arrancó la goleada del Crystal Palace contra el Lech Poznan (4-0) y también forzó un penalti
articles.summary: El campeón del mundo arrancó la goleada del Crystal Palace contra el Lech Poznan (4-0) y también forzó un penalti
articles.body: No es muy normal que un equipo de la talla del Crystal Palace cuente en sus filas con un jugador como Yeremy Pino. La temporada pasada ya fue clave en la conquista de la Conference League contra el Rayo Vallecano... y se encargó de abrir el marcador en la goleada contra el Lech Poznan (4-0) en el estreno de la Europa League 26-27. El Palace, que venía de caer ante el Ipswich en Premier, ubicó en portería a Walter Benítez ante la lesión de Dean Henderson. Tampoco estaban disponibles Imaïlia Sarr ni Mateta. Mingueza, por su parte, arrancó el duelo desde el banquillo... pero sí disfrutó de minutos en la segunda parte. El tanto del Yeremy Pino, el primero que marca este curso el flamante campeón del mundo con España, apenas tardó 10’ en llegar. A partir de ahí, todo fue rodado para el Crystal Palace: Chris Richards, a centro de Wharton desde el córner, hizo el 2-0 y el propio Yeremy Pino fue víctima de un penalti que fue materializado por Strand Larsen. Ya en el ocaso del encuentro, el Lech Poznan se quedó con uno menos por la doble amarilla que recibió Murawski en poco más de 10' de diferencia. Situación que aprovechó el Crystal Palace para cerrar la goleada gracias al tanto de Eddie Nketiah antes de que se cumpliese el tiempo reglamentario.

articles.title: Man City 5-0 Norwich: Floyd Samba enjoys dream debut with double to book place in Carabao Cup fourth round for Enzo Maresca's side
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Carabao Cup third-round tie between Manchester City and Norwich City at the Etihad Stadium; Floyd Samba, son of ex-defender Chris, scored twice on debut; Allan also marked first appearance with a goal and Rayan Cherki scored
articles.body:
Samba, 17, the son of former Premier League defender Chris, introduced himself in perfect style with his stooping header to open the scoring before Rayan Cherki doubled City's lead soon after.

Having assisted the first for Samba, fellow debutant Allan joined in on the scoring after dancing into the box and driving a low shot into the bottom corner to mark another emphatic introduction to the home fans at the Etihad Stadium.

Samba built on his strong start to life in the senior squad, as his father watched on from the stands, when he calmly curled home a fourth goal for City.

Norwich were denied a consolation goal when substitute Mohamed Toure's effort was disallowed for offside, meaning the visitors walked away without a shot on target registered, and Ryan McAidoo would add to their misery with a late goal to make it five for the hosts.

A sixth straight win for Enzo Maresca's side now tees up a fourth-round clash with Brighton at home in the next round.

29: GOAL! Dream debut for 17-year-old Samba as his stooping header opens the scoring.

32: GOAL! Cherki doubles the lead with a neat finish into the bottom corner after latching onto an Ayyoub Bouaddi pass.

39: BIG CHANCE FOR SAMBA! The young forward takes it in his stride and breaks into the box but Bruno Alves makes a strong recovery challenge to deal with the danger before he can shoot.

48: GOAL! Allan scores on his debut after assisting the opener with a low driven shot into the bottom corner.

54: GOAL! The pick of the goals as Samba grabs his second with a curling effort into the bottom-right corner.

68: MCAIDOO DENIED! Samba at the heart of it again as he feeds in McAidoo, who has a low strike across goal which is well saved by Daniel Grimshaw.

74: DISALLOWED! Toure slots a consolation goal in but the offside flag cuts their celebrations short.

90: GOAL! McAidoo completes the scoring with a fifth goal for the hosts.

Maresca praises debutants Samba and Allan

"Not just for the two goals, for the entire performance he was good. He didn't play many games as a nine, we tried in the last two or three games.

"He is very good at finishing the action. It was a good game for him. I have said since day one, I am happy with the way we are working.

"It was not an easy game. The players were serious and professional."

On the performance of Allan on debut: "It was not easy for him, first time with 90 minutes. It is always complicated but it was important for him to play.

"English competition is different to South America. He has scored a goal and an assist so overall, he is happy.

"We have many games and we are just at the beginning of the season. The ones who play tonight will play Premier League or Champions League."

'Enzo's dream start at Man City rolls on'

Sky Sports News' Ben Ransom at the Etihad Stadium:

"Enzo Maresca's perfect start as Man City boss is rolling on. Since his players lifted the tempo, they have shown more than enough energy and craft.

"To make 10 changes and win so handsomely is a real statement of intent. Not many would have predicted Maresca winning his first six competitive matches after taking over from Pep Guardiola.

"With Cherki off at half-time attention can now firmly switch towards the visit of Sunderland at the weekend, and the ambition to make it a perfect seven before the international break."

"The team played in a good structure, well organised and the boys were disciplined. After 20 minutes, Man City started to get a little bit annoyed because they could not create.

"Then you get the first goal and we need to do better on that cross. Then on a transition they get a second goal; we were naive.

"There are good lessons to take. We missed the right choices in the final third; we had some good opportunities. We scored a goal but it was offside.

"I saw good individual performances from players but it is hard to take five goals with just six shots on target. Those are not good statistics."

articles.standfirst: Los de Iñigo logran su primera victoria en esta Liga tras remontar ante el Málaga
articles.summary: Los de Iñigo logran su primera victoria en esta Liga tras remontar ante el Málaga
articles.body: Se había hecho esperar, pero ya está aquí. El proyecto de Iñigo Pérez en este Villarreal puso su primera piedra sólida en una construcción cuya inestabilidad amenazaba con el desastre. Tuvo que levantarse en La Rosaleda, remontar el tanto inicial de Dotor y confirmar su primera victoria de la temporada gracias a los goles de Moleiro y Gueye, por partida doble. Pese al mal momento del equipo amarillo, lo cierto es que la diferencia con el Málaga pesó demasiado en el desenlace del partido. Los de Funes parecen más de lo que son. Combinan, ofrecen calidad en la circulación pero las carencias y debilidades terminan tapando sus virtudes. En defensa hace aguas con demasiada facilidad y eso, ante un equipo como el de Iñigo Pérez, acaba pesando. Da igual que el Villarreal pase por un momento bajo de confianza o que Mikautadze y Gerard no se presentasen de inicio en La Rosaleda. Es una cuestión de calidad. Y eso fue lo que se acabó imponiendo. Basta con ver el primer tiempo de Ilias Akhomach para que uno tome conciencia de la plantilla que tiene Iñigo entre manos. Seguramente el jugador menos utilizado de todo el frente de ataque fue el que maniató al Málaga en cada arrancada por banda. Mientras sus servicios se iban al limbo, huérfanos de un rematador contundente, el Málaga golpeó primero en una gran transición. Larrubia marcó la pausa y Dotor se abrazó a la fortuna para, en un remate mordido, encontrar el gol, previo desvío de Pau Navarro. Herrero sostenía al Málaga mientras Ortiz Arias se mostraba comprensivo con una entrada de Salinas que acabó con Comesaña lesionado. En ese cambio, cosas del fútbol, se decantó el partido del lado amarillo. Porque el senegalés culminó una remontada que señaló Moleiro. El canario empató en un remate a placer tras un jugadón de Ilias. Eso fue en el 40'. Y en el añadido, justo antes de enfilar el camino a vestuarios, decíamos, Gueye confirmaba el cambio de rumbo tras asociarse con Ayoze y definir ante la salida de Herrero. Movió Funes el banquillo tras el descanso pero el escenario no solo no cambió, sino que se intensificó con un Villarreal ambicioso y sin presiones. Se soltaron los de Iñigo, que tuvieron el tercero en un cabezazo de Ayoze en el área pequeña que Recio sacó por un puro instinto de supervivencia. El tercero del equipo amarillo siempre sobrevoló La Rosaleda según avanzaba el segundo acto. Lo pudo hacer Mikautadze, que en la primera que tuvo se encontró con el palo. Y justo cuando más inquietaba el Málaga y disfrutaba de sus mejores minutos, encontró el Villarreal una transición. Su hábitat natural. Y del gol anulado a Carlos Romero se pasó al penalti a favor de los de Iñigo. Y Gueye bajó el telón. Para borrar de un latigazo la depresión del submarino. Para instalar, hasta nuevo aviso, la angustia en La Rosaleda.

articles.title: Real Sociedad 1-2 Bournemouth: Justin Kluivert and Rayan goals in Europa League clash hand Cherries first-ever European win
articles.summary: Report as Bournemouth won 2-1 at Real Sociedad in the Europa League; the visitors led 2-0 at half-time thanks to goals from Justin Kluivert and Rayan; Sociedad pulled one back just before hour mark through Sergio Gomez; the Cherries hung on to record a first-ever European win
articles.body:
The Cherries had been surprisingly made favourites to win the Europa League, but Marco Rose watched his team justify their tag with a professional display on the road.

Kluivert's 11th-minute goal was followed by Rayan's header nine minutes later, and although Sergio Gomez pulled one back, Bournemouth held on to claim all three points from their first match in Europe.

This fixture at San Sebastian was the latest chapter in a remarkable story for the Cherries, with a first European tie in the club's history occurring only 18 years on from them being mired in financial trouble and on minus 17 points in the fourth tier of English Football.

After Eddie Howe masterminded a great escape and three subsequent promotions, last season's sixth-place finish under Andoni Iraola earned a place in the Europa League, but Rose was the man tasked with ensuring Bournemouth marked history with a win.

20: GOAL! Rayan heads home Alex Scott's gorgeous lofted pass to put the visitors in control.

25: POST! Evanilson almost adds a third, only for his glancing header to hit the post with the 'keeper beaten.

57: GOAL! Gomez brings the hosts back into the contest with what looked to be a cross from out wide.

85: GREAT SAVE! Orri Oskarsson is found in space in the box, but Djordje Petrovic does well to keep out the striker's low drive.

90+1: WHAT A SAVE! Petrovic again comes to Bournemouth's rescue with a sensational close-range reaction stop to deny Oskarsson at the back post.

articles.title: Crystal Palace 4-0 Lech Poznan: Eagles breeze past Polish champions to record victory on first Europa League outing
articles.summary: Report as Crystal Palace beat Lech Poznan 4-0 to claim victory on their maiden Europa League outing; Yeremy Pino opened the scoring early on, before goals from Chris Richards, Jorgen Strand Larsen and substitute Eddie Nketiah wrapped up all three points at Selhurst Park
articles.body:
Last season's Conference League winners almost got off to the worst possible start, but Mikael Ishak missed the target for the visitors from six yards out, with just three minutes on the clock.

They were made to pay moments later when Yeremy Pino intercepted a 20-yard throw across the edge of his own penalty area from Terry Yegbe, with Pino striding into the area and popping the ball into the corner.

Palace's second was even more simple, with Chris Richards rising highest at the back post from an Adam Wharton corner to steer his header across the goalkeeper and into the net.

Pino was also instrumental in the third, intercepting on the left flank before gliding into the area where he was clumsily brought down by Radoslaw Murawski. The referee gave a penalty and Jorgen Strand Larsen made no mistake, drilling across the goalkeeper and into the top-left corner.

Murawski was sent off late in the second half after collecting his second caution of the game and Palace capitalised just before full-time with a nice finish from substitute Eddie Nketiah.

Nketiah had come on at the same time as Ismaila Sarr, who received a mixed reception from Palace fans as he made his first appearance of the season since a failed summer move to Liverpool.

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: Celtic 1-3 Ferencvaros: Martin O'Neill's Hoops punished in Europa League opener as they lose at home
articles.summary: Report as Celtic lose to Ferencvaros; Liam Scales' own goal put the visitors ahead; Mika Baur levelled, but Kristoffer Zachariassen restored the lead; Daniel Arzani scored a third; it is back-to-back defeats for Martin O'Neill ahead of Sunday's Premiership clash with Rangers, live on Sky
articles.body:
Martin O'Neill vowed his team would get things right after their League Cup collapse against Rangers, but it was more of the same after a promising start against the Hungarians.

They had plenty of early possession, but were soon a goal down when Liam Scales turned Bamidele Yusuf's shot into his own net after Kieran Tierney had failed to deal with a cross.

With half-time approaching, Mika Baur slammed the ball into the net to pull Celtic level only for the visitors to quickly restore their lead.

Yusuf beat Tierney and Callum McGregor was too slow to clear the ball, leaving Kristoffer Zachariassen to flick the ball past the returning Viljami Sinisalo.

The mistakes continued in the second half. Colby Donovan, handed his first Scotland call-up this week, was caught out and Australian winger Daniel Arzani smashed the ball into the top corner.

Celtic did have a flurry of late chances, but they could not salvage anything from the game, leaving them with back-to-back defeats ahead of Sunday's Premiership clash with Rangers, live on Sky Sports.

23: SAVE! Arzani gets past Cameron Carter-Vickers, but Sinisalo gets down to push the ball wide.

31: CHANCE! Haissem Hassan tries to meet Forrest's cross at the back post, but Cadu is there to clear.

32: CLOSE! Hassan sends the ball to McGregor on the edge of the box, but his strike is deflected past for a corner.

44: GOAL CELTIC! What a time to equalise! Tierney sends the cross into Baur to slam into the net.

45+1: GOAL FERENCVAROS! Nightmare from Celtic! Yusuf beats Tierney and McGregor before setting up Zachariassen to flick the ball past Sinisalo.

47: GOAL FERENCVAROS! Celtic lose possession far too easily and Arzani punishes their latest mistake with a brilliant strike into the top corner.

67: CHANCE! Carter-Vickers sends the ball to Duran to cross in for Kasper Hogh, but it just evades the Celtic sub.

73: CHANCE! With Varga well off his line, Nygren strikes from distance but it is over the bar.

articles.title: Premier League predictions & Jones Knows' best bets: Brentford to expose soft Chelsea underbelly
articles.summary: Our football betting expert Lewis Jones previews the weekend Premier League action; Watch Brentford vs Chelsea, Nottingham Forest vs Coventry, Bournemouth vs Liverpool, Leeds vs Crystal Palace, Man City vs Sunderland & Fulham vs Man Utd live on Sky Sports; Play Super 6!
articles.body:
Brentford vs Chelsea, Friday 8pm, live on Sky Sports

Chelsea have been vulnerable to exactly the sort of physical, second-ball and set-piece football Brentford specialise in. There is a softness about them which was exposed by Hull City, who scored from a corner when Emi Martinez failed to deal cleanly with a delivery. Brentford will be licking their lips and getting their knives and forks ready for a set-piece feast.

Out of the 17 ever-present Premier League teams since the start of last season, Chelsea have conceded the second most goals from set-pieces at 0.5 per game and the Bees have hit them via this method in previous fixtures, amassing a per-game average of 0.73 for expected goals from set-pieces from the past three meetings.

Chelsea look there for the taking with Brentford on offer at Evens in the draw no bet market.

Tottenham vs Aston Villa, Saturday 12.30pm

There is a striking amount of evidence pointing towards a low-scoring game.

Tottenham's problems in front of goal are well documented - zero scored in four Premier League matches to a backdrop of just 0.95 expected goals per game. Roberto De Zerbi's teams averaged 1.92 goals scored per game at Brighton and Marseille, so to average just 0.73 per game since taking the Spurs job showcases a worrying trait for the environment at the club. There seems a "mental block" holding this football club back.

Villa have scored just one goal themselves this season in the Premier League. Both teams have genuine attacking-process problems, but for different reasons. Tottenham have possession and territory without enough penetration while Aston Villa are struggling to generate much shot volume at all.

Under 2.5 goals at 10/11 with Sky Bet looks too good to turn down.

SCORE PREDICTION: 1-1 | JONES KNOWS' BEST BET: Under 2.5 goals (10/11 with Sky Bet)

Fabian Hurzeler has yet to taste victory over Mikel Arteta across five meetings but his Brighton team have certainly bloodied the nose of the champions. In games that have produced plenty of needle - even between the managers - Brighton have won four of the five expected goals battles which points towards this being a tricky encounter for the visitors despite their perfect start to the season.

I'd be wary of taking the 7/10 with Sky Bet for an away win, with the double chance for Brighton at 11/10 much more appealing.

Olivier Boscagli should be lining up against Bukayo Saka, who looks back to his dangerous best with the ball. The winger has drawn 13 fouls in three Premier League games, with three of those fouls leading to a booking for the opponent. Boscagli is 5/4 with Sky Bet to make two or more fouls and is 4/1 to be carded - a price given further edge by his two previous cards in two games with Arsenal.

We were on Leif Davis to score or assist the week before last, then decided not to follow him into the Crystal Palace game last weekend - and, of course, he went and did both. That's betting for you. It makes us resilient.

Davis is playing a role that makes him far more than your traditional left-back. He is getting extremely advanced for Ipswich, constantly pushing into the final third and becoming a genuine attacking outlet. His two goals and an assist in the opening four Premier League games underline just how involved he is.

There is also a lovely little momentum angle here. If we include pre-season, Davis has scored four times in his last seven games. That is some output from a player starting from left-back.

The shot-on-target price is the interesting bit. The 100/30 with Sky Bet feels big for a player whose positioning means he is regularly getting himself into attacking areas.

SCORE PREDICTION: 2-1 | JONES KNOWS' BEST BET: Leif Davis +1 shot on target (100/30 with Sky Bet)

Newcastle United vs Hull City, Saturday 3pm

There is something about a team getting absolutely battered that makes me interested in opposing them in their next game. It is not just the physical exertion of chasing shadows for 90 minutes - there is a psychological hangover that can linger.

Newcastle certainly got a beating at Leeds. They were 4-0 down before eventually losing 4-1, with Matthias Jaissle admitting afterwards that the result was "difficult to digest" and that his young side could not match Leeds' physicality.

When looking at teams conceding four or more goals in a Premier League game, excluding matches against Arsenal, Manchester City and Liverpool, their record in their next game is horrible. Just one win from the last 15, alongside five draws and nine defeats.

That makes Hull or draw at 11/8 with Sky Bet interesting.

Nottingham Forest vs Coventry City, Saturday 5.30pm, live on Sky Sports

James McAtee is a fantastic bet here to be carded.

To put the case simply: a player who is playing in a Premier League midfield - the most physical and duel-heavy major league in Europe - that has made seven fouls in his last two games, picking up a yellow card in both, should not be 13/2 with Sky Bet to be carded again. It's a classic case of a positional change with a player not being factored into the market yet as McAtee is doing a fine job of replacing Elliott Anderson's hustle and bustle in the Forest midfield. Big price.

SCORE PREDICTION: 2-0 | JONES KNOWS' BEST BET: James McAtee to be carded (13/2 with Sky Bet)

Bournemouth vs Liverpool, Sunday 2pm, live on Sky Sports

Narrative is always worth listening to in football betting. Andoni Iraola returning to Bournemouth with Liverpool feels like one of those occasions where the emotional temperature at the Vitality Stadium could be turned up a few degrees.

Iraola spent three seasons on the south coast, taking Bournemouth to their highest-ever Premier League finish before moving to Anfield this summer. He returns on Sunday for the first time.

There are some interesting historical parallels, too. Managers returning to former clubs for the first time can find the occasion awkward. David Moyes lost at Everton with Manchester United, Graham Potter lost at Brighton with Chelsea, while Thomas Frank drew at Brentford with Tottenham, Brendan Rodgers drew at Swansea with Liverpool and Mauricio Pochettino drew at Southampton with Tottenham.

These results highlight the unusual dynamics of these fixtures. The home crowd knows the manager, the players know the manager and there is an extra edge to the occasion.

Bournemouth are 19/10 with Sky Bet for the win.

Leeds United vs Crystal Palace, Sunday 2pm, live on Sky Sports

Betting on Leeds when the price is right is a wise strategy, because more often than not, you know exactly what you're getting. Organisation, aggression, a threat from set pieces and a team where everyone looks comfortable playing the same way.

Leeds have lost just one of their last 13 Premier League matches dating back to March, winning six and drawing six. That's the fewest defeats of any side in the division over that period. Their latest performance was another reminder of the formula, too, as they dismantled Newcastle 4-1 at Elland Road.

But it is the first-half numbers that really catch my eye.

Across their last 19 games, Leeds have conceded just two goals before half-time, keeping 17 first-half clean sheets in that sequence. That is an extraordinary level of consistency and it tells you something about how well-drilled they are from the first whistle.

Crystal Palace, meanwhile, have already conceded 11 goals in their opening four league games. So I'm going back to the Leeds factor. The Leeds/Leeds half-time/full-time price of 7/4 with Sky Bet appeals.

Manchester City vs Sunderland, Sunday 2pm, live on Sky Sports

There is one Premier League opponent still missing from Erling Haaland's hit list...Sunderland.

He has scored against 24 of the 25 teams he has faced in the competition with the Black Cats the only exception. That makes this feel like a particularly dangerous fixture for Sunderland, especially given the ridiculous form Haaland is currently enjoying.

He has scored in each of his last three Premier League appearances and nine times across his last nine league games. His latest effort, the winner against Manchester United at Old Trafford, was another example of that ruthless efficiency.

So, rather than taking the short price on Haaland to score on its own, I want to add a couple of conditions to boost the price.

Haaland to score in a Manchester City win and under 3.5 goals is 11/8 with Sky Bet.

Sunderland can be awkward opponents to break down while City have generally been winning games without necessarily turning every victory into a goal-fest.

Fulham vs Manchester United, Sunday 4.30pm, live on Sky Sports

Another poor result before the extended international break would not be ideal for Michael Carrick, who is already finding himself in the familiar cycle that has engulfed Manchester United managers in recent seasons. United have won just one of their opening four league games and then threw away a 2-0 lead against Brighton in midweek.

The Evens about an away win is tempting, particularly because Fulham will make this an open game. That should suit United's attacking players, but I'm more interested in a goals-based angle.

These two sides have had the joint-most touches in the opposition box in the Premier League this season, with 139 each. That is a useful indicator of the attacking intent we could see at Craven Cottage.

No player has touched the ball more in the opposition box than Josh King, who has 30 such touches this season. He has also scored twice from 11 shots, with five of those efforts finding the target.

That makes the 11/8 with Sky Bet for both teams to score and King to have one or more shots on target particularly appealing.
